findings.explanation: You are required to perform additional services requested by the client during the term without any extra pay, increasing your workload without compensation.
findings.suggested_change: Contractor shall perform the Services described in this Agreement, and any additional services requested by the Client shall be subject to a separate written change order and mutually agreed fees.

findings.suggested_change: [CLIENT_NAME] may request up to three rounds of revisions for each Deliverable, after which additional revisions will be billed at Contractor's standard hourly rates.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a few adjustments before signing. - In the relevant clause concerning additional tasks, the agreement requires extra services to be provided without additional pay. I propose changing this so that any additional services are subject to a separate written change order and mutually agreed fees. - Regarding the provision on revisions, the agreement currently allows for unlimited changes until full satisfaction is reached. I propose modifying this to allow up to three rounds of revisions for each deliverable, with additional revisions billed at standard hourly rates. Thank you for considering these updates, and I look forward to finalizing the agreement soon. Best regards.
